settings.label: Quality Override
settings.help: Leave empty to follow the player. Options: standard / higher / exhigh / lossless / hires. Your account must have access to the requested quality.

settings.label: Sign-in Method
settings.help: Leave empty or use qr for QR sign-in; use web for website sign-in.

settings.label: Unlock unavailable songs
settings.help: Ask a self-hosted unlock service when a song has no full stream. Off by default.

settings.label: Unlock service
settings.help: The service you deployed: api-enhanced (route /song/url/match) or UnblockNeteaseMusic-utils (route /match). Both repositories are linked in the README.

settings.label: Unlock service URL
settings.help: Base URL of your deployment, e.g. https://music-api.example.com. Leave empty to disable.
